en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own trip and get the same access-first plan before you book anything
en.runTitle: Melbourne to Kyoto and Osaka: six autumn days by manual wheelchair on AUD 7,500

fields.label: Chair dimensions, transfer needs and roll-in shower requirements
fields.value: Manual wheelchair used full-time; can stand briefly for transfers

fields.label: Flight times
fields.placeholder: e.g. land at Kansai 9:30, fly home 17:00

fields.label: Budget excluding flights
fields.value: AUD 7,500 for the two of them

en.template: Plan Kyoto and Osaka for {dates} with {chair}, {companion}, {flights} and {budget}. Prioritize guaranteed room allocation, staff-assisted rail, a fitted replacement-chair fallback and written medical/aid-cover terms. Separate dated prices from allowances and flag what is still unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone, sharing personal information or booking.

phases.title: Research official access information, prices and breakdown backups in both cities
phases.note: Rail and stations, hotel rooms and insurance, autumn sights and food
phases.judgment: It would not claim a roll-in shower it could not prove: the hotel pages give bed heights (54 cm in Kyoto, 53 cm in Osaka), but no step-free roll-in shower was fully verified, so the guide says to get the exact room confirmed in writing before booking.

phases.title: Write the guide, source list and budget with the arithmetic shown
phases.note: Day-by-day plan, hotel table, budget in yen and Australian dollars
phases.judgment: The budget is labelled conditional, not a quote: ¥667,000 (AUD 7,021.05) including a 15% buffer at an assumed ¥95 to the dollar. The guide also lists what is still open: guaranteed roll-in rooms, 2027 hotel prices, medical underwriting and out-of-hours replacement chairs.

phases.title: Independent check of every money figure, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed all 15 budget rows and the other money figures from scratch and found nothing to correct, while saying plainly what it could not confirm: booking suitability and future affordability.

workers: Checked rail routes, fares, staff boarding help and which station gates and platforms are step-free, plus taxi and wheelchair-repair leads
Inspected hotel pages for two accessible-room candidates in each city and read the travel-insurance wording on mobility aids
Checked official Kyoto and Osaka access guides for temples, gardens and food streets that suit a manual wheelchair
Recomputed every money figure on its own and checked the guide’s claims against its source list

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的行程，订任何东西之前先拿到同样以无障碍为先的计划
zh.runTitle: 墨尔本到京都、大阪：手动轮椅的六天秋日行，预算 7,500 澳元

fields.label: 轮椅尺寸、转移需要和可直接进入式淋浴要求
fields.value: 全程使用手动轮椅，转移时能短暂站立

fields.label: 航班时间
fields.placeholder: 例如：上午 9:30 抵达关西，下午 17:00 返程

zh.template: 为{dates}的京都和大阪之旅做计划，需求是{chair}、{companion}、{flights}和{budget}。优先落实保证房间分配、车站协助、适配的备用轮椅及书面医疗和器具承保条款。区分有日期的价格与预留，标出尚未确认之处。联系他人、分享个人信息或预订前先问我。

phases.title: 查证两地的官方无障碍信息、价格和轮椅故障备用方案
phases.note: 铁路与车站、酒店客房与保险、秋景景点与餐饮
phases.judgment: 没有把查不实的说成有：酒店页面只给了床高（京都 54 厘米、大阪 53 厘米），完整的无门槛淋浴并没有被证实，所以指南要求订房前先拿到书面确认的具体房间。

phases.title: 写成指南，配上来源清单和写明算式的预算
phases.note: 逐日行程、酒店对照表、日元和澳元预算
phases.judgment: 预算标明是有条件的估算，不是报价：含 15% 机动费用共 ¥667,000（约 7,021.05 澳元），按假定的 ¥95 兑 1 澳元计算。指南还列出仍未落实的事项：保证有无门槛淋浴的房间、2027 年酒店价格、医疗核保，以及非营业时间的替换轮椅。

phases.title: 独立复核每一笔金额，并测试电脑和手机版面
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事从头重算了全部 15 行预算和其他金额，没有发现需要更正之处，同时直接说明它无法确认的两点：是否适合订房，以及将来是否负担得起。

workers: 查证铁路路线、票价、车站人员协助上车，以及哪些检票口和站台无台阶，并整理无障碍出租车和轮椅维修线索
查看酒店官网，为京都和大阪各找出两家有无障碍客房的候选，并读了保险条款里关于助行器具的约定
对照京都、大阪官方无障碍指南，筛出适合手动轮椅的寺院、庭园和美食街
独立重算每一笔金额，并把指南里的说法逐条对回来源清单
